summary: 碳酸锂与氢氧化锂产能并非完全可自由切换；不同原料路线、苛化/转化工序、杂质控制和客户认证会限制产品切换速度，因此‘锂盐总产能’不能直接按价格在两种产品间重分配。
why_search_may_miss_it: 公司常披露总锂盐吨数，市场模型容易默认产品结构可即时切换。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 separated product grades but not physical product-switching constraints
recalled_details.schema_implication: chemical capacity needs product_route and qualified_swing_capacity

suggested_queries: 碳酸锂 转 氢氧化锂 苛化 产能 切换
lithium carbonate hydroxide conversion causticization swing capacity
disconfirmation_queries: all lithium chemical capacity can switch freely between carbonate and hydroxide
disconfirmation_source_types: 实际产品结构与切换时间

summary: 锂盐转换成本受硫酸、纯碱、烧碱、石灰、天然气/蒸汽等大宗化工与能源投入影响；这些外部价格和供应约束会使相同锂原料成本下的转换利润明显不同。
why_search_may_miss_it: 锂行业成本曲线常聚焦矿价，基础化工与能源成本分散在其他行业数据中。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 captured feedstock unit consumption but not non-lithium reagent and energy bridges
recalled_details.schema_implication: conversion cost stack needs reagent/energy intensity and price vintages

suggested_queries: 碳酸锂 硫酸 纯碱 烧碱 天然气 成本
lithium conversion sulfuric acid soda ash caustic energy cost
disconfirmation_queries: lithium conversion margin depends only on lithium feedstock price

summary: 锂盐生产会形成母液、返料和不合格品回流，部分锂在系统内循环后再回收；若只用一次投料和一次成品计算收率，会混淆单程收率、总回收率和在制库存。
why_search_may_miss_it: 公开成本和产量数据通常不给内部循环物流，导致‘回收率’定义跨项目不可比。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 formalized feedstock consumption/recovery but not internal recycle and single-pass versus overall yield
recalled_details.schema_implication: chemical yield requires boundary definition and recycle/WIP semantics

suggested_queries: 碳酸锂 母液 回收 返料 收率 工艺
lithium carbonate mother liquor recycle yield rework
disconfirmation_queries: lithium chemical single-pass yield always equals overall recovery

summary: 部分锂盐产量可能来自受托加工/代加工：原料或成品所有权属于客户，转换企业只赚加工费。统计行业产量、企业销量和原料采购时若不区分tolling与自营，会发生重复计量和错误利润归属。
why_search_may_miss_it: 公司公告和行业统计可能都记录吨产量，但不一定说明原料/成品所有权和收入确认方式。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 covered captive/external feedstock mix but not tolling ownership semantics
recalled_details.schema_implication: chemical output needs ownership_role and tolling flag to avoid double counting

suggested_queries: 锂盐 代加工 受托加工 来料 加工费
disconfirmation_queries: all reported lithium chemical production is merchant-owned output
disconfirmation_source_types: 收入确认/原料所有权资料

summary: 电池级锂盐的包装、洁净控制、金属杂质与批次一致性会影响可交付性；散装工业级产量不能简单视为同等可进入高端正极客户的库存。
why_search_may_miss_it: 产品等级标准通常只给化学指标，实际客户对包装、异物与批间一致性还可能有额外约束。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 captured purification and customer qualification but not delivery/packaging quality as effective-supply semantics
recalled_details.schema_implication: qualified lithium chemical inventory needs packaging and customer_spec state

suggested_queries: 电池级 碳酸锂 包装 磁性异物 客户 规格
battery grade lithium carbonate packaging magnetic impurity specification
disconfirmation_queries: all chemically on-spec lithium salt is immediately fungible across customers

summary: 锂盐产业库存应区分原料矿、焙烧中间料/浸出液、母液、工业级中间品、电池级成品和交易所仓单；价格快速变化时库存可能在不同质量层级和所有权主体之间迁移。
why_search_may_miss_it: 市场库存通常只统计成品或仓单，而工厂内部大量锂可能停留在不同工序和品质状态。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 distinguished price markets but did not map chemical-chain inventory by process/quality/ownership state
recalled_details.schema_implication: inventory needs process_stage, grade, owner and deliverability dimensions

suggested_queries: 碳酸锂 在制品 母液 库存 仓单 工厂
lithium carbonate WIP mother liquor inventory warehouse receipt
disconfirmation_queries: finished lithium carbonate inventory fully represents lithium held in conversion system
